name: Miner Info
description: Hashrate, temperature, power and fan readings from one Bitcoin miner
config_help:
Point this at one miner's BOS REST API.

Braiins OS miners only — other firmware does not serve this API.

Add the widget once per miner to watch several at a time.

miner_url.name: Miner URL
miner_url.description: Base BOS REST API URL for the miner

miner_password.name: Miner password
miner_password.description: Password for root login. This is stored as normal widget text until secret params exist.
